function.name: update_user_profile
function.description: Updates the user profile with the provided details. If certain details are not provided, existing information is retained. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user.

email.description: The updated email address for the user.

phone.description: The updated phone number for the user in E.164 format, such as '+1234567890'.

preferences.description: The updated preferences for the user. If not provided, the default preferences will be used.

newsletter_subscribed.description: Indicates if the user is subscribed to the newsletter.

birthdate.description: The updated birthdate of the user in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

message.content:
Hello! I’m your friendly AI assistant—think of me as a versatile helper ready to tackle a wide range of tasks:

| What I Can Do | How It Helps You |
|---------------|------------------|
| **Answer Questions** – From quick facts to deep explanations on science, history, tech, culture, etc. | Get instant knowledge or learn something new. |
| **Write & Edit Text** – Draft emails, essays, reports, creative stories, poems, code snippets, or polish drafts. | Save time and improve clarity, tone, style, or structure. |
| **Brainstorm Ideas** – Generate concepts for projects, marketing campaigns, product names, event themes, recipes, etc. | Spark creativity when stuck or looking for fresh angles. |
| **Plan Projects** – Create outlines, timelines, checklists, budgets, or project plans. | Organize work efficiently and keep track of milestones. |
| **Translate Languages** (up to ~30 languages) | Communicate across cultures or understand foreign texts. |
| **Explain Complex Topics** – Break down jargon into simple terms. | Make learning easier whether it’s math, physics, finance, coding, etc. |
| **Provide Recommendations** – Books, movies, music, travel spots, gadgets based on interests. | Discover new favorites tailored to your taste. |
| **Assist With Coding** – Write, debug, explain algorithms, or review code. | Speed up development and troubleshoot issues. |
| **Help With Learning** – Study guides, flashcards, practice problems, exam prep strategies. | Boost academic performance or skill acquisition. |

And there’s more—I can also generate summaries, create quizzes, simulate conversations, offer mental‑health support resources, draft legal documents (with disclaimer), and even play games like trivia or word puzzles!

Just let me know what you’d like to accomplish next, and I'll tailor my response accordingly. 🚀
message.reasoning:
The user asks "Hi, what can you do?" This is an open question about capabilities. We should respond explaining our abilities and ask how we can help.

We don't need to call any tool here. Just answer text.
